title: Prithvika
subtitle: A Coal Land Reclamation, Research & Innovation Campus
scope: Site strategy · Master planning · Architectural design · Sustainability systems
description: Prithvika reimagines a scarred coal‑mined landscape in Chandrapur as a living laboratory — a research and innovation campus rooted in ecological repair.

The design bridges post‑mining land remediation and the institutional needs of a research campus through phytoremediation, mycoremediation and biochar strategies, layered with a low‑impact architectural language of fly‑ash brick, stone and timber.

Every drawing in this section is authored end‑to‑end — from literature and case studies (David Rubenstein Treehouse, Fraunhofer, CSIR‑NEERI) through site analysis, zoning, service calculations, and finally the detailed block plans and elevations.

title: Crest Harbour
subtitle: Vertical Housing Complex
description: A vertical housing complex investigating density, community and daylight along Hyderabad's rapidly growing residential edge.
Modular unit plans stack around shared skygardens, breaking the typical monolithic tower into a family of pavilions.

title: Monjee University of Management
subtitle: Institutional Campus Planning
scope: Master planning · Block design · Landscape framework
description: A campus master plan for a management university that weaves academic, administrative and residential programmes through a spine of shaded courtyards.
The plan responds to Bhubaneswar's climate with deep overhangs, north‑lit studios and continuous verandahs.

title: Unit One Market
subtitle: Urban Market Redevelopment
description: A redevelopment of a Bhubaneswar neighbourhood market, layering informal vending, cold storage and civic plaza under one continuous shading canopy.
The design negotiates between the messy vibrancy of Indian street trade and the need for hygiene, circulation and shelter.

title: Evolve.io
subtitle: Architectural Office Interior
description: An interior study for a small architectural firm's studio — bringing together open collaboration areas, a materials library and a quiet drafting mezzanine.
The palette is intentionally restrained: raw plaster, oiled ply and warm task lighting.

title: Nirmaan
subtitle: Working Drawings — Apartments
description: A set of construction drawings for two apartment typologies — exploring how conventional Indian residential detailing translates into precise CAD language.
Included here as evidence of comfort with door schedules, wet‑area details, plinth sections and tile layouts.

title: Aalo–Chhaya
subtitle: Sustainable Pavilion using Waste
description: A pavilion concept using construction waste and reclaimed textiles, exploring the interplay of light and shade.
Recognised in the Top 60 of the ANDC 2023 competition.

title: VDS 2023
subtitle: Futuristic Floating Habitat
description: A speculative floating habitat designed for the Vertical Design Studio 2023 brief, exploring self‑sufficient life on rising seas.

title: Sketchbook
subtitle: Basic Design, Illustrations & Graphic Art
description: A curated selection of sketches, illustrations and graphic explorations that continue to inform the architectural work.
